title: iOS on-device tennis audio event detection evaluation
description: A focused multi-turn chat evaluation case for testing wiki-native synthesis across engineering roadmap, model selection, dataset preparation, evaluation metrics, iOS deployment, and MVP-to-production planning.
topic: Design an iPhone on-device tennis audio event detection system that detects hit timestamps and rally boundaries from video audio, then deploys the pipeline on iOS.
evaluation_focus: wiki-page synthesis across concept, comparison, workflow, entity, and source pages
multi-turn context reuse for MVP-to-production planning

turns.question: 我想在 iPhone 上做网球击球声音检测，整体应该怎么做？
expected_pages: concepts/iOS端侧音频序列机器学习模型部署路线与选型.md
expected_behavior: resolve the short request as an engineering roadmap rather than a generic iOS audio explanation
cover audio extraction, Log-Mel features, baselines, model training, Core ML conversion, and real-device testing
recommend a baseline-first path before a custom lightweight production model

turns.question: SoundAnalysis、能量峰值、自定义 CNN/TCN 模型分别适合什么场景？我应该优先选哪个？
expected_behavior: compare roles instead of treating the three options as equivalent alternatives
position SoundAnalysis as a prototype/coarse activity baseline
position energy peaks as a low-cost timestamp baseline with false-positive risk
position a custom Log-Mel CNN/TCN model as the main production path

turns.question: 如果我要训练这个模型，数据集和标注应该怎么准备？OpenSportsLab 和 SPOT Tennis 应该怎么选？
expected_pages: concepts/短瞬态声音事件时间点检测.md
expected_behavior: inherit the tennis audio detection context from previous turns
recommend OpenSportsLab for engineering-start convenience and SPOT Tennis for fine-grained label semantics
describe timestamp, event labels, annotation windows, and tolerance-based evaluation needs

turns.question: 如果我不只想识别击球点，还想识别一回合的开始和结束，模型结构应该怎么设计？

expected_behavior: move from single hit detection to a multi-task model
include shared Log-Mel backbone with hit, rally_start, and rally_end heads

connect the design to iOS Core ML deployment constraints

turns.question: 怎么判断这个方案有没有效果？我应该设计哪些评估指标和实验对比？
expected_behavior: separate event-level metrics from rally-level metrics
include Precision, Recall, F1, Timing MAE, tolerance-based F1, and false positives per minute
compare SoundAnalysis, energy peak baseline, and custom model results
recommend a short-video loop before scaling to the full dataset
